purpose: Freeze development-only selection policy before E5 comparison and sealed holdout search
ordering: Highest minimum hit rate across original, English development, client-translated Korean development
Highest arithmetic mean MRR across those three sets
Lowest measured p95 latency; prefer BM25 on an exact tie
rawKorean: Report separately as backend diagnostic. Translated Korean is explicitly an MCP client workflow; never relabel it as raw Korean backend success. A server-only consumer does not receive this translation automatically.
sealedHoldout: Unopened. Select and freeze one candidate first, then evaluate original frozen query text without silently replacing questions. Any separately client-translated run must preserve the original, use a frozen pre-search translation manifest, and report its distinct inputs. Do not tune against holdout results while calling them independent.
